semantic_scope: A character rests exactly one hand on their own hip; ownership and one-hand cardinality distinguish it from related tags.
display_candidate: 自分の腰に片手を置く
source_excerpt: A character resting one hand on their own hip. Not to be confused with hands on own hips, where the character is resting both hands on their hips.

semantic_scope: The character's gaze is directed to their side relative to the character's own front, not relative to the viewer; it is gaze direction rather than body orientation.
source_excerpt: When a character's gaze is directed to something off to their side. Most commonly are eyes looking 90 degrees across the shoulder, but may also include up to 45 degrees facing in either direction. Looking to the side is relative to the character's front, not the viewer's perspective.

semantic_scope: Detached sleeve-style cuffs worn at the wrist; explicitly not restraint cuffs/handcuffs/shackles.
source_excerpt: A detached sleeve cuff, made of material such as fabric, leather, fur, or metal. For tagging purposes, wrist cuffs look like wristbands but with frills, button holes, or other distinctive features that closely match the appearance of the cuffs that would be found on a shirt's sleeve. For restraints, use cuffs, handcuffs, or shackles.

semantic_scope: Short hair at the back combined with long sidelocks in front of or behind the ears, with the long locks at least shoulder length.
display_candidate: 長い横髪のショートヘア
search_candidate: 長い横髪のショートヘア
source_excerpt: A hairstyle consisting of short hair in back with long sidelocks in front of or behind the ears, with the locks at least shoulder length.

semantic_scope: Two or more characters hold each other's hands; this is an inter-character relation, not one person's own hands together.
source_excerpt: When two or more characters are holding each other's hands.

semantic_scope: A character places or rests one hand on their own chest, without fondling/groping; two hands use a different canonical.
display_candidate: 自分の胸に片手を置く
source_excerpt: When a character places or rests one of their hands on their own chest, without fondling or groping themselves. If both hands are involved, use hands on own chest.
